title: A Dynamical Theory of the Electromagnetic Field (Abstract)
version: Proceedings of the Royal Society, vol. 13, pp. 531–536, scan of original published abstract.
lineage: Original contemporary abstract inspected, not the complete 1865 paper; sufficient for its explicit empirical attribution and wave proposition.

passages.note: pp. 533–534: induction, lines of force and explicit empirical foundations in Faraday, Felici and Ørsted.
